project_type: Python robotics reliability platform with MuJoCo simulation, PyTorch ML, file-based JSON storage
verification_instructions: 1. Run python3 -m pytest tests/ -v and confirm all tests pass. 2. Run python3 -c 'from forge_core.edge_deploy import OnnxExporter, OnnxPolicy, EdgePolicy' to verify imports.
environment_constraints: TensorRT is NEVER a pip dependency — detect at runtime, skip gracefully when absent. onnx/onnxruntime are optional under [edge] extra. Tests must pass without TensorRT via pytest.mark.skipif. MuJoCo rendering needs MUJOCO_GL=egl in CI.
contribution_requirements: forge_core/ has ZERO ROS dependency. Everything is YAML-driven. Tests in tests/unit/ and tests/integration/. CLI scripts in scripts/. Docs in docs/architecture.md, docs/setup.md, README.md.

key_patterns.policy_abc: forge_core/policy.py — Policy ABC with reset(sim), act(sim)->ndarray, done->bool, name->str properties
key_patterns.policy_registration: forge_core/policy.py — POLICY_REGISTRY dict + create_policy() with lazy imports for ML-dependent policies
key_patterns.network_shape: forge_core/learned_policy.py — PolicyNetwork(obs_dim=31, act_dim=8, hidden=[256,256,128]), MLP with Tanh, forward(obs)->action
key_patterns.observation: forge_core/learned_policy.py — extract_observation(sim, target_object) returns 31-dim float32 ndarray, OBS_DIM=31, ACT_DIM=8
key_patterns.model_registry: forge_core/model_registry.py — ModelRegistry with register_model(), get_model(name, version, stage), list_models(), promote(), stages: training->validated->production->archived
key_patterns.runner_registry_loading: forge_core/runner.py — load_policy_from_registry(name, version, stage, **policy_kwargs) uses ModelRegistry + create_policy('learned', model_path=...)
key_patterns.test_pattern: tests/unit/ — sys.path insert for project_root, pytest fixtures with tmp_path, TestXxx classes, no ROS deps
key_patterns.pyproject_extras: pyproject.toml — [ml] extra for torch, [dev] for pytest

directory_structure: forge_core/ = core lib (no ROS), scripts/ = CLI tools, tests/unit/ = unit tests, tests/integration/ = acceptance, config/ = YAML configs, docs/ = architecture.md + setup.md, registry/ = model registry JSON, models/ = .pt checkpoints, simulation/scenarios/ = YAML scenarios, tasks/ = YAML task defs, faults/ = YAML fault profiles, baselines/ = regression baselines
